page_title: DOR 2-2 HEI | Dortmund v Heidenheim 01/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' That's it for today, Tobias Reichel has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+12' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
90+11' Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jan-Niklas Beste.

90+11' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar! What an opportunity that was! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
90+9' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
90+8' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
90+7' Omar Traore (Heidenheim) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
90+6' Omar Traore (Heidenheim) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+4' A poor mid-range free-kick by Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) is easily blocked by the defensive wall.
90+3' Emre Can (Dortmund) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Tobias Reichel ignores the protests.
90+2' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
90+1' Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
90' The fourth official shows 12 min. of added time.
90' Frank Schmidt has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Florian Pick (Heidenheim) replacing Eren Dinkci.
90' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) replaces Marcel Sabitzer.
88' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Tobias Reichel signals. There is a free kick near the sideline to Dortmund.
87' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
85' The game is interrupted now, Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
82' 2 - 2 Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Gregor Kobel to move before rolling the ball into the middle of the goal!
82' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) is going to take the penalty!
82' Having seen unsporting behavior, Tobias Reichel shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Sebastien Haller (Dortmund) is the recipient.
81' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Heidenheim!
80' Referee Tobias Reichel makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
79' The attendance for today's match is 80000.
78' Edin Terzic has decided to make a change. Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) replaces Sebastien Haller.
77' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Tobias Reichel changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
77' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Heidenheim as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.

77' Sebastien Haller (Dortmund) is penalised for holding. Tobias Reichel signals a set piece. PENALTY to Heidenheim! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
76' Heidenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
76' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) glances on a header from the corner sent into the near post, but his close-range effort is blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Heidenheim will have an opportunity.
76' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
75' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Heidenheim.
72' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) on the edge of the box.
71' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) brings his opponent down. Tobias Reichel has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Dortmund will take a free kick.
68' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
64' Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
64' Here is a change. Karim Adeyemi is going off and Edin Terzic gives the last tactical orders to Felix Nmecha (Dortmund).
63' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.

62' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.

62' He should have scored! Donyell Malen (Dortmund) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Kevin Muller makes an easy save.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim) comes onto the pitch so that Adrian Beck can be given a rest.
61' It's like he was asking for a caution. Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) receives a yellow card.
61' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) receives a yellow card for infringement.
61' 2 - 1 Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. He hits the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and it nestles in the net.
60' Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) fails to turn the rebound in as the goalkeeper pulls off a great save to keep him out.
60' The corner from Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) is intercepted by Gregor Kobel.
57' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) unleashes a shot, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
57' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) sees a yellow card from Tobias Reichel after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

57' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
56' Kevin Muller pulls off a great save to deny Donyell Malen (Dortmund) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
56' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for handball!
54' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the goal using the VAR system.
53' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Tobias Reichel due to a handball, much to the disappointment of the Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) and his team.
52' Emre Can (Dortmund) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tobias Reichel saw the whole situation. Heidenheim get a free kick.
50' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
50' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety. It will be a corner kick for Dortmund.
49' What a wasted opportunity by Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Gregor Kobel makes a decent save to thwart him.
48' A brilliant cross into the box finds Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
48' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Frank Schmidt probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim). He is replaced by Marvin Pieringer.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.

43' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
42' Dortmund enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
41' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Donyell Malen (Dortmund) causes Kevin Muller little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.

38' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
37' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall charges down the ball.
35' That's a free kick to Dortmund.
35' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Tobias Reichel didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
32' One of the players from Heidenheim times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
30' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:2.
28' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

28' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Kevin Muller. Dortmund have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
27' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Gregor Kobel.

26' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the left post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.

25' Nice touch by Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) as he latched on to an accurate cross and attempted to direct the ball with a fine header towards the net, but the goalkeeper reacted quickly to keep it out.
25' The referee signals a corner kick to Heidenheim.
24' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Heidenheim. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Heidenheim.
21' Emre Can (Dortmund) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
19' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Heidenheim was in an offside position.
19' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
17' A player from Heidenheim commits a rough challenge. Tobias Reichel blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
15' 2 - 0 Goal! Emre Can (Dortmund) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Kevin Muller to commit before slotting the penalty into the left of the goal.
15' Emre Can (Dortmund) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
14' The Dortmund players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
14' Referee Tobias Reichel makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Dortmund. Let’s see what happens!
13' Surely that's handball by one of the Heidenheim players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
11' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
7' 1 - 0 GOAL! Julian Brandt (Dortmund) got to the ball in front of the goal and he couldn't miss from there. His strike went in off the crossbar. The score is 1:0.
2' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Heidenheim will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Tobias Reichel.
